ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(GenerateApprovedforExamLetter__c), GenerateApprovedforExamLetter__c = true, NOT(ISPICKVAL( Phase__c , "A - Application Received")), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Phase__c , "B - Board Review")), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Phase__c , "E - Executive Officer Review")), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Phase__c , "X - Exam Phase")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not able to generate the "Approved for Exam Letter" if the Application is not on Phase A, B, E or X
